notes.title: Add difficulty levels and Customize buttons
notes.content:
[b]add difficulty levels[/b]
on the top left of the main screen,  you can choose the game difficulty 
[Easy, Medium, Hard]

[b]Customize buttons[/b]
You can now customize the buttons through the settings button

notes.title: Control Customization
notes.content:
Add [b]Control Customization[/b]
Change every aspect of controls according to your style. Grant yourself complete control freedom by choosing and adjusting commands for [u]dash[/u], [u]jump[/u], [u]fire[/u], and [u]assist[/u]. Select what suits your play style and make the game perfectly tailored to your preferences
